items.address: 830 5th Ave, New York, NY 10065 (enter Central Park at 59th St & 6th Ave)

items.exceptions: 2026-27 calendar (official): 15 Feb 2027 (Presidents' Day) is a Community Day — free admission for NYC public-sector employees and their families; remaining tickets at Peak. 16–21 Feb 2027 = Peak; 22 Feb–13 Mar 2027 = Off-Peak; 14–16 Mar 2027 (end of season) = Community Days, free for everyone. items.costTwoAdults: Feb 16–21 (Peak): $56 for two (2 × $28 adult) + $24 skate rental if needed (2 × $12; all prices incl. tax). Feb 22 onwards (Off-Peak): $32 for two (2 × $16) + $24 rental. 15 Feb 2027: free only for public-sector employees/families (Community Day); everyone else pays Peak.
